en.title: Hacker News: Vancouver Strip Club Loses Instagram Over Lake Joke Sign
en.hook: A Vancouver strip club's Instagram was taken down after a sign with a lake joke violated platform rules, according to Hacker News.
key_takeaways: The club's Instagram account was removed due to a sign referencing a lake
The incident highlights strict content moderation policies on social media platforms
Hacker News scored 21 points with 12 comments
